//==
// # Color spaces
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Color spaces and color science
//  - Device-independent color models
//  - Palettes, harmony, and color difference
//  - Device-referred and video color models

//==
// # Color spaces and color science
//
// The vocabulary that *defines* a color space: chromaticity coordinates, white
// points and standard illuminants, primaries, transfer characteristics, and the
// chromatic adaptation and rendering intent a conversion between two spaces
// needs. The color representations themselves are the device-independent and
// device-referred/video sections below.
// Conversions are functions in a later pass; these types name the endpoints
// and the knobs.

//==
// ## Chromaticity and white points

// A CIE 1931 xy chromaticity coordinate: a color's hue-and-purity position on
// the chromaticity diagram, independent of luminance.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chromaticity)
type Chromaticity
    implements IValue, IHashable
{
    X: Number;
    Y: Number;
}
